newsitem.title: USA: AMEX to trade options on Microsemi, Bemis shares.
newsitem.headline: AMEX to trade options on Microsemi, Bemis shares.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange said it would offer options on the listed stock of Bemis Co and over-the-counter shares of Microsemi Corp.

Bemis Co options will begin trading May 20, opening with strike prices of 35, 40 and 45. Initial expiration months will be June, July, October and January. The specialist unit will be Group One Trading.

Microsemi options will begin trading May 21 and will open with strikes of 10, 12-1/2 and 15 and expiration months of June, July, September and December. The specialist will be AGS Specialist Partners.
